title: Effect of cobalt doping on the physicochemical and photocatalytic properties of Cu2BaSnS4 thin films
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35660-35676
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05156H, Paper

Adel Chihi
Cobalt (Co)-doped Cu2BaSnS4 (CBTS) thin films were synthesized via the sol–gel dip-coating method to investigate the effect of Co incorporation on their physicochemical properties and photocatalytic activity.
